headline: Rohit Sharma addresses 2027 World Cup speculation
description: Rohit Sharma said the October 2027 ODI World Cup is still far away and indicated that it is too early to make a decision about his participation.

headline: Rohit focuses on upcoming ODI assignments
description: With speculation continuing around the 2027 World Cup, Rohit Sharma is focusing on India's upcoming ODI commitments rather than looking too far ahead.

headline: Rohit and Kohli's 2027 World Cup future remains under discussion
description: Former India seamer Ashish Nehra said it is too early to determine whether Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli will feature in India's 2027 ODI World Cup campaign.

headline: Rohit Sharma scores 138 at Lord's
description: Rohit Sharma scored 138 against England in the third ODI at Lord's, producing a memorable century during India's chase.

headline: Rohit keeps ODI future open after Lord's century
description: Following his impressive 138 at Lord's, Rohit Sharma remained in focus amid discussion about his future in India's ODI setup.

headline: Rohit Sharma talks about India's cricket future
description: Rohit Sharma spoke about his vision for Indian cricket and expressed his desire for India to become a powerhouse of world cricket.
